summary: WiseKey International Holding filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the filing of a Form F-4 registration statement for a proposed redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands via a merger into a wholly owned BVI subsidiary. No price, stake, premium, or deal value is stated; the transaction is subject to shareholder approval at an EGM on September 9, 2026, SEC effectiveness, Nasdaq and SIX listing authorizations, and Swiss Takeover Board confirmation. This is a change of domicile, not a change of control, and is not a special situation category. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a corporate reorganization, not an acquisition, delisting, or other special situation.
